Follow all local electrical codes during installation. All wiring must conform to local and national electrical codes. Improper wiring or installation may damage the thermostat and equipment. Recognize safety information. This is the safety-alert symbol . When you see this symbol on the equipment and in the instruction manual, be alert to the potential for personal injury. Understand the signal words DANGER, WARNING, and CAUTION. These words are used with the safety-alert symbol. DANGER identifies the most serious hazards which will result in severe personal injury or death. WARNING signifies a hazard which could result in personal 1

injury or death. CAUTION is used to identify unsafe practices which may result in minor personal injury or product and property damage. NOTE is used to highlight suggestions which will result in enhanced installation, reliability, or operation. This document outlines the instructions required to initiate the relearning process for the thermostat part numbers listed in Table 1 whenever any equipment control board shown in Table 2 is replaced. These instructions should also be used after firmware updates are made via a USB-based reprogramming interface to hardware which supports InteliSense™/SmartSense™. Relearn Process for ecobee Thermostats To initiate the relearning process, follow the steps below. NOTE: The screens provided are for a 2-stage furnace control board, but the steps apply to all boards listed in Table 2. 2.1. ecobee3 lite/Smart Thermostat LITE (SKUs EB-STATE3LTICR-01, EB-STATE3LTICB-01, EB-STATE3LTIBR-01, EB-STATE3LTIBB-01, EB-STATE7ICR-01, EB-STATE7IBR-01) 3

1. From the Home screen, press the hamburger menu, to transition to the Main Menu System screen. On the Smart Thermostat Lite models, pressing the hamburger menu button will take you directly to the Main Menu screen where the Settings option can be selected. Proceed to Step 3.
